arguments.message: The purchase request for 500 units of KX-40 brackets will not be executed, as the approval has been withdrawn per the supervisor’s report. No further action will be taken at this time. If you need to revisit this order, please let me know.

delegation:
Message to Executor:

Do not proceed with purchasing the 500 units of KX-40 brackets. According to a recent supervisor report, the approval for this purchase has been withdrawn. No action is needed at this time. Please notify the principal that the purchase request will not be executed due to lack of approval.

registry.policy_text: Ridgeline purchasing policy: an order on the Net-30 purchasing account needs a purchase approval from the purchasing manager, recorded in the approval system; the approval fixes the part, the side and the maximum order value.
